bullets.title: NVDA Financing Plan Divides Wall Street; Circular Financing Debate Intensifies
bullets.body: Nvidia unveiled a $500B financing plan with six financial firms to fund chip customers, with CEO Jensen Huang addressing concerns about circular financing. Critics, including Apollo's Slok, argue AI profits are still funded by investors rather than customers ('math doesn't make sense'), while hyperscaler CDS volumes hit all-time highs on circular financing fears. Separately, analyst modeling suggests an HBM downspec across Rubin GPUs could enable 30–50% more GPU shipments from the same HBM supply, and NVDA was cited as a beneficiary of potential Bank of Korea SWF-driven AI infrastructure financing alongside AVGO.

bullets.title: Systematic Buyers Set to Reload NVDA, MU, SNDK, LITE as Leverage Unwind Completes
bullets.body: Per Bloomberg/Citadel, systematic strategies are poised to add exposure to NVDA, MU, SNDK, and LITE as the leverage reset has largely run its course and volatility conditions have normalized. A separate memory-conference takeaway noted ASP flattening is not a sign of oversupply, with higher contract/spot LTA mix expected to support pricing and data-center demand keeping memory tight.

bullets.title: NVDA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Lightning; Nemotron 4 Trillion-Parameter Model in Development
bullets.body: NVIDIA launched Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30B-parameter mixture-of-experts model for high-volume specialized AI agent tasks, with NeMo Switchyard for multi-model workflow routing. Separately, The Information reports NVIDIA is developing Nemotron 4 as an open-source model expected to have at least 1 trillion parameters, signaling further AI ecosystem leadership.

bullets.title: GOOGL Gemini Surpasses 1B Monthly Users — Fastest-Growing Product Ever
bullets.body: Google CEO Sundar Pichai announced Gemini now has over 1 billion monthly active users, calling it Google's fastest-growing product ever and its 14th product to reach 1B users. One observer noted the milestone may be inflated by Gemini being auto-installed in Gmail.

bullets.title: INTC $20B Share Sale Massively Oversubscribed; AI Foundry Narrative Drives Institutional Demand
bullets.body: Intel upsized its share offering to $20B after institutional demand came in several times the available shares — roughly 1-in-3 investors received zero allocation. The offering was priced into a rally, not distress, with capital earmarked for the AI foundry business. Unusual $5M+ call option flow in INTC was also flagged ahead of the deal.

bullets.title: TSMC July Revenue Hits Record as AI Fills Every Wafer Slot; CoWoS Near Capacity
bullets.body: TSMC's July revenue reached record levels as AI demand fills every available wafer slot. Industry sources indicate TSMC is close to, but not quite, meeting demand, with CoWoS packaging constraints being discussed at OCP APAC.

bullets.title: AAPL: Pay/Wallet Executive Departing in October; India Manufacturing Accelerating
bullets.body: Apple's executive overseeing Pay and Wallet services is leaving in October. Separately, Apple is aggressively expanding iPhone production in India to hedge China geopolitical exposure, signaling a meaningful manufacturing diversification push.

bullets.title: TSLA Most Bullish Options Flow; Morgan Stanley Says Robotaxi Proof Needed
bullets.body: TSLA registered the most bullish options flow of the session. Morgan Stanley flagged that Tesla must demonstrate clear Robotaxi scaling to maintain investor confidence, with stronger FSD adoption cited as supporting sentiment.

bullets.title: AMZN Far-Dated Put Selling Signals Bullish Long-Term Positioning
bullets.body: Options flow showed millions of dollars in far-dated 2027 AMZN put selling, reflecting bullish positioning in long-dated expiries. Amazon's market cap trajectory — reaching $3T in under 10 years from $1T — was also highlighted as context for long-term bull thesis.

bullets.title: PLTR Sees Millions in Put Orders; Unusual Bearish Flow Flagged
bullets.body: Large put orders worth millions were placed on PLTR, suggesting traders are positioning for downside in the name. No fundamental catalyst was cited alongside the flow.

bullets.title: MPWR: Analyst Initiates Buy with $1,706 PT on AI Power Demand
bullets.body: An analyst initiated a Buy rating on Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) with a $1,706 price target, citing key positioning in AI power infrastructure for GPUs and ASICs, VPD module uplift, firm pricing from DrMOS shortages, and growing design wins in storage, enterprise data, and automotive. EPS estimates: $28 (2026E) and ~$49 (implied 2027E).

bullets.title: ORCL CDS Widens Back Above 200bps Amid Hyperscaler Credit Stress
bullets.body: Oracle CDS spreads moved back above 200 basis points. This follows broader reports of hyperscaler CDS volumes hitting all-time highs amid circular financing and debt concerns flagged by Nomura (viewing gold as a 'pressure release valve' for hyperscaler debt).

bullets.title: SNOW: Trump's May 21 Purchase Preceded Amazon AI Deal; Stock Up 94% Since
bullets.body: Trump filed a SNOW stock purchase on May 21, less than a week before Snowflake announced an AI compute deal with Amazon. The stock has risen 94% since the trade, drawing attention to timing.

bullets.title: Fed Rate Hike Odds Near 50/50 Ahead of July CPI; Warsh Building New Policy Framework
bullets.body: Fed funds futures price a 51% probability of a 25bp September hike, 49% for no move, and zero probability of a cut. Multiple Fed officials (Goolsbee, Venable) called inflation the 'biggest problem' facing the economy. WSJ's Nick Timiraos flagged July CPI as a critical test of whether inflation can hit 2% without more tightening. Separately, Chair Warsh's task forces appear designed to replace the current policy framework, though the old framework remains operative for now.

bullets.title: Oil Surges on Hormuz Closure Threat; EIA Raises Brent Forecast to $87
bullets.body: Iran reiterated Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until conditions are met, driving oil above $83 (WTI below $82, Brent ~$88). EIA raised its 2026 Brent forecast to $87/bbl (from $82) and US gasoline to $3.78/gal. Energy Secretary Wright said nearly 9M bpd is moving through the strait. US SPR is at a 36-year low below 300M barrels, limiting the administration's ability to talk oil prices down.

bullets.title: Meta Custom Silicon MTIA Targets Ad Recommendation, Not LLM Inference
bullets.body: Meta exec Matt Steinberg explained that LLMs have 'embarrassingly parallel' problems suited to general chips, while ad recommendation systems are personalized and require distinct optimization — driving Meta's custom MTIA chip development specifically for recommendation workloads.

bullets.title: SaaS Competitive Dynamics Fundamentally Shifted; AI TAM Risk of Underestimation
bullets.body: Benchmark VC Eric Vishria noted the SaaS competitive frontier has 'completely changed,' invalidating previous winning assumptions. Separately, he warned investors risk repeating the cloud-era mistake of undersizing AI's market — in 2014, the narrative wrongly assumed AWS would capture all value, but Snowflake and others emerged as major enterprise players.

bullets.title: SPY Options: $6.3B Call Wall at 773, Puts at Cheapest of the Year Ahead of CPI
bullets.body: $6.3 billion in calls are positioned at SPY 773 with $4B+ positive gamma at 780, suggesting significant bullish market structure. Meanwhile, 1-month 25-delta SPY puts are trading at 14% IV — the lowest since December 2025 — creating an asymmetric setup ahead of CPI and PPI data.

bullets.title: IBM Partners With Together AI on $240M NVDA HGX B300 Inference Cluster
bullets.body: IBM signed a $240M multi-year deal with Together AI to deploy a large-scale inference cluster on IBM Cloud running NVIDIA HGX B300 systems and Spectrum-X Ethernet networking, expected available Q1 2027. The deal adds to a broadening list of NVDA hardware deployment MOUs.

bullets.title: TX Data Center Moratorium Seen as Tailwind for Neoclouds HUT, CRWV with Existing Infrastructure
bullets.body: The Texas moratorium on new data center construction is viewed as a positive catalyst for operators with established facilities (HUT, CRWV), as it reduces competitive capacity additions. Neoclouds were cited as trading higher pre-market.
